name: Foundation of Remembrance
description: Tapu Fini's gift of the Silver Waters allows her worshippers to ask and see memories of the recent deceased.
effect: Devotees of the Spirit Guardian of Remembrance may call upon "Foundation of Remembrance" once per quest as a bonus action to summon Misty Terrain. At Luminary, they may expend 1 Will when their Terrain would end for any reason. If they do so, they retain a personalized Misty Terrain that only affects them and can exist with another Terrain. This personalized Terrain lasts for 4 Turns. Furthermore, at Luminary, only you and your allies cannot be affected by Status Conditions when under the effects of Misty Terrain. At Paragon, as long as any Terrain is active you gain +2 Chance Dice to any rolls that require Chance Dice.
